title: Honcho Cock Arms/Shoulders
author: Tanner W.
desc: Get honcho cock arms and shoulders

ex.note: Pause every rep for 0.5-1 second
Spam partials at the end. Don’t bother adding weight until you can consistently get 14+ each set with good form.

Alternating each arm
Lean into it
Once your forearm reaches your bicep let your elbows drift up slightly before beginning the next rep
Lean back to make more tricep focused
Once you reach technical failure, use more and more body English to squeeze out more rels
When you cant get the weight up do a 5-10 second hold at the end of the set

10-20 Rep range
Partials until you can’t move the weight once technical failure is hit

10-20 Rep range
Lateral raise partials once you hit technical failure
Stop immediately after form break down
Add body English to get more reps once technical failure is mef
